topic: Gerunds vs. Infinitives (动名词与动词不定式的妙用)
teaching_notes: 同学们，动词有时候也喜欢‘变身’！当一个动词跟在另一个动词后面时，它通常要变成‘-ing’形式（动名词）或者‘to + 动词原形’（不定式）。一般来说，表达已完成或习惯性的动作常用 -ing，而表达目的、计划或未发生的动作常用 to do。还有些特殊的动词（如 remember、stop）跟两者都可以，但意思截然不同哦！例如：1. She promised to help me with my English. (她许诺要帮我——还没发生，用 to do) 2. I finished reading this storybook yesterday. (我已经读完了——已完成，用 -ing)。

questions.question: My sister enjoys ______ pictures of birds in the park every weekend.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面必须接动名词形式做宾语，即 enjoy doing sth.，表示‘喜欢做某事’。

questions.question: We have decided ______ to London for our winter vacation.
questions.explanation: decide 后面接动词不定式做宾语，即 decide to do sth.，表示‘决定做某事’。

questions.question: The teacher asked the students to stop ______ because the exam was starting.
questions.explanation: stop doing sth. 表示‘停止正在做的事情’；stop to do sth. 表示‘停下来去 做另一件事’。这里是让学生停止说话，故选 A。

questions.question: I am looking forward to ______ my grandparents during the National Day holiday.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须接动名词形式 (-ing)，表示‘期待做某事’。

questions.question: Lucas is very good at ______ basketball and has won several school matches.
questions.explanation: be good at 中的 at 是介词，介词后面需要用动名词形式，即 be good at doing sth.。

questions.question: My little brother wants ______ a doctor when he grows up.
questions.explanation: want 后面接不定式，固定搭配为 want to do sth.，意为‘想要做某事’。

questions.question: Please remember ______ off the lights before you leave the classroom.
questions.explanation: remember to do sth. 表示‘记得去做某事（还没做）’；remember doing sth. 表示‘记得做过某事（已做）’。离开前要关灯是提醒去执行的动作，故选 A。

questions.question: You should avoid ______ sweet food if you want to keep your teeth healthy.
questions.explanation: avoid 属于只能接动名词 (-ing) 的动词，avoid doing sth. 意为‘避免做某事’。

questions.question: The children hope ______ the science museum this afternoon.
questions.explanation: hope 后面习惯接不定式做宾语，固定结构为 hope to do sth.，表示‘希望做某事’。

questions.question: Sam spent two hours ______ his math homework yesterday evening.
questions.explanation: spend + 时间/金钱 + (in) doing sth. 是固定句型，表示‘花费时间/金钱做某事’。

questions.question: Would you mind ______ the window? It's a bit stuffy inside.
questions.explanation: mind 后面接动名词，Would/Do you mind doing sth.? 表示‘你介意做某事吗？’。

questions.question: The two boys agreed ______ their bedroom together.
questions.explanation: agree 后面接不定式，agree to do sth. 表示‘同意/答应做某事’。

questions.question: I will never forget ______ the famous astronaut at school last year.
questions.explanation: forget doing sth. 表示‘忘记做过某事（动作已发生）’；forget to do sth. 表示‘忘记要去 做某事（动作未发生）’。句中有 last year，表示已经见过，故选 A。

questions.question: After ______ her report, Emma turned off her computer.
questions.explanation: after 是介词，后面跟着动词时要用动名词形式 (-ing)。

questions.question: The little boy refused ______ the bitter medicine.
questions.explanation: refuse 后面接不定式，refuse to do sth. 表示‘拒绝做某事’。

questions.question: It is important for primary students ______ enough sleep every day.
questions.explanation: 在句型 It is + adj. + for sb. + to do sth. 中，It 是形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式 (to do)。

questions.question: David practices ______ the violin for half an hour every evening.
questions.explanation: practice 后面只能接动名词做宾语，即 practice doing sth.，表示‘练习做某事’。

questions.question: Our class plans ______ a tree-planting activity next spring.
questions.explanation: plan 后面接不定式作宾语，plan to do sth. 表示‘计划做某事’。

questions.question: The problem was very hard, but Ben tried his best ______ it out.
questions.explanation: try one's best to do sth. 是固定短语，表示‘尽某人最大努力去做某事’。

questions.question: Are you interested in ______ the school drama club?
questions.explanation: be interested in 中的 in 是介词，介词后接动名词形式 (-ing)。

questions.question: What would you like ______ for lunch, hamburgers or noodles?
questions.explanation: would like 后面接不定式，would like to do sth. 表示‘想要做某事’。

questions.question: Although it was raining heavily, the football team kept ______ on the field.
questions.explanation: keep doing sth. 表示‘持续/继续做某事’，keep 后接动名词。

questions.question: My parents promised ______ me to the amusement park if I pass the exam.
questions.explanation: promise 后面固定接不定式，promise to do sth. 表示‘承诺/许诺做某事’。

questions.question: The doctor suggested ______ a walk after dinner for better digestion.
questions.explanation: suggest 后面直接跟动词时，必须用动名词形式 (-ing)，即 suggest doing sth.。

questions.question: He left the room quietly without ______ anyone.
questions.explanation: without 是介词，后接动词时要使用动名词 (-ing) 形式。

questions.question: On the way home, my uncle stopped ______ a picture of the beautiful sunset.
questions.explanation: stop to do sth. 表示‘停下手中的事，去 做另一件事’。叔叔是停下来去拍日落，故选 B。

questions.question: Jenny needs ______ more water after doing such intense exercise.
questions.explanation: 当主语是人时，need 作为实义动词，后面接不定式，即 need to do sth. 表示‘需要做某事’。

questions.question: Don't give up ______! You are getting closer to success.
questions.explanation: give up 中的 up 是副词/介词短语，后接动名词，give up doing sth. 表示‘放弃做某事’。

questions.question: The kind man offered ______ the old lady carry her heavy box.
questions.explanation: offer 后面接不定式作宾语，offer to do sth. 表示‘主动提出做某事’。

questions.question: Mom is busy ______ dinner in the kitchen right now.
questions.explanation: be busy doing sth. 是固定句型，表示‘忙于做某事’，忙于的具体动作使用动名词形式。
